text:
kim: Heads-up: external assessor confirmed. They want a tamper-evident log bundle + KMS signature and an RBAC change history for last 45 days. Need a tight plan for upload window and evidence artifacts.

rachel: copying previous approach but let's add an explicit verification manifest and include CloudTrail event ids for the KMS Sign() and PutObject. That speeds up audit triage.

sanjay: agree. plan: 1) create ephemeral role `arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/pt-assessor-upload-3340` with sts:AssumeRole for the assessor principal, timeboxed to 90m. 2) run packager job in staging to produce bundle + sha256 + manifest.json. 3) sign digest using KMS key alias/pt-handshake-v2.

dave: infra will add packager script to ci:infra. Quick draft snippet:```bash
TARBALL=bundle-$(date +%s).tar.gz
tar -czf $TARBALL /var/log/redwood/ --mtime='2024-01-01'
sha256sum $TARBALL > $TARBALL.sha256
aws kms sign --key-id alias/pt-handshake-v2 --message fileb://$TARBALL.sha256 --signing-algorithm RSASSA_PSS_SHA_256 --output text --query Signature | base64 -d > $TARBALL.sig
aws s3 cp $TARBALL s3://redwood-pt-handshakes/$TARBALL --sse aws:kms --sse-kms-key-id alias/pt-handshake-v2
```

kim: couple of clarifying asks from assessor: a) include last rotation timestamp of the KMS key and whether key policy allows CloudTrail read-back, b) provide a short list of PRs that touched `authz/` and `rbac/` directories for 45d window, c) confirm bucket retention and replication status.

rachel: I can pull the PRs and format into `authz_changes.md`. I'll also get the key rotation date from KMS: yesterday it shows "2025-02-12T03:44:22Z" in the console. I'll cite the key id `arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456789012:key/abcd-ef01-2345`.

sanjay: CloudTrail logs show KMS Sign events as `KMS:Sign` in eventName. We'll include a snippet with the exact event IDs for the test sign in staging. Note: make sure we don't include full AWS creds in the bundle.

dave: infra will produce `manifest.json` with fields: ["bundle_name","sha256","signed_by","kms_key_arn","kms_key_alias","kms_last_rotation","signing_principal","file_count","earliest_log_ts","bucket_sse","bucket_retention_days"]. Example entry: `{
  "bundle_name": "bundle-1670000000.tar.gz",
  "sha256": "...",
  "signed_by": "arn:aws:iam::123456789012:user/ci-runner",
  "kms_key_arn": "arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456789012:key/abcd-ef01-2345",
  "kms_key_alias": "alias/pt-handshake-v2",
  "kms_last_rotation": "2025-02-12T03:44:22Z",
  "signing_principal": "ci-runner@redwood",
  "file_count": "124",
  "earliest_log_ts": "2025-01-20T00:00:00Z",
  "bucket_sse": "SSE-KMS",
  "bucket_retention_days": "365"
}`

kim: good. RBAC window length? assessor prefers short windows. propose 45 minutes upload + 20 minutes verification. keeps blast radius small.

rachel: 45+20 is fine. we'll rotate the role credentials immediately after verification and publish audit entry in our change log.

sanjay: I'll create the role and post the policy snippet here when done. Policy will be least-privilege: s3:PutObject (specific prefix), s3:GetObject for the verification principal, kms:Sign for key alias, and sts:AssumeRole for the assessor AWS account.

dave: One more: include an automated verification script that runs `aws kms verify` or equivalent to assert the signature before marking the bundle as ready. I'll add that to the CI job and fail if verification fails.

assessor-bot: Note: please include the earliest and latest log timestamps included, and whether any logs were redacted. Also confirm retention policy for exported artifacts outside Redwood.

kim: action items: rachel -> authz_changes.md + key rotation proof; sanjay -> create role + policy + post ARN; dave -> infra packager + verify step + PR; kim -> assemble the upload runbook and coordinate exact handoff timestamp.

rachel: pulling PRs now, will attach short summaries (author, PR link, files changed).

sanjay: role created in staging: arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/pt-assessor-upload-3340 (will tighten before prod). Pre-signed URL window will be 3340500000-3340502700 (approx).

dave: opened PR infra#712 with packager and verify job. Running staging job now.

kim: retest slot suggestion from assessor: Tue 04/15 09:30-10:30 PT. hold tentatively. Everyone OK?

rachel: ok for sec-eng.

sanjay: ok.

dave: ok. I'll make sure CI artifact retention covers at least 90 days for evidence.

kim: good. final checklist for this thread before handoff:
- bundle.tar.gz, bundle.sha256, bundle.sig
- manifest.json with KMS metadata and earliest/latest timestamps
- authz_changes.md (45d)
- role ARN + pre-signed URL + upload window timestamps
- retention/replication note for s3 bucket

kim: i'll post the handoff timestamp and pre-signed link in this thread once CI completes and verification passes. Thanks team :rocket:
